name: ASML
notes: US GAAP figures from SEC Form 20-F (ASML also publishes IFRS statements; not used). revenue = 'Net sales' / 'Total net sales'; operatingIncome = 'Income (loss) from operations'. FY ends Dec 31. 2000-2004 restated for Track/Thermal discontinued operations. 2016-2017 restated for ASC 606 (2017 originally 9,052.8 net sales). 2009 op. loss -165.0 per FY2009 20-F (later filings show -163.1). Revenue and op income for some 2010-2015 years taken from different later 20-F XBRL facts (both URLs: OperatingIncomeLoss and SalesRevenueNet companyconcept). FY2025 from 20-F filed 2026-02-25.
